name: HTTP Cookie (Set-Cookie Header)
description:
Detects HTTP Set-Cookie header values in text content such as logs, traffic captures, and API responses. Cookie values frequently carry session tokens, authentication credentials, and tracking identifiers. Matches the full attribute chain following the name=value pair.

Format: Set-Cookie: name=value[; attributes]
Note: Targets the Set-Cookie response header, not Cookie request headers, to avoid false-positive matches on bare name=value pairs in non-HTTP contexts.

effect.message: HTTP Set-Cookie header redacted (may contain session token or auth credential)
